description: Fills a cube of seeded random values and reads 32 of them out at a point set by three voltages, so a smooth move through the cube gives 32 smooth voltages

params.text: Sets the density the distribution is built with, 0.001 to 1; what it changes differs by distribution, and with Discr it sets the chance that a value is 10V rather than 0V
Sets the seed the cube is filled from, 0 to 1
Picks the distribution the cube is filled with: Discr, Weib, Beta, Cauchy or Exp

inputs.text: Moves the reading point along the first axis of the cube, 0-10V across its whole width
Moves the reading point along the second axis of the cube, 0-10V across its whole width
Moves the reading point along the third axis of the cube, 0-10V across its whole width
Picks the distribution by voltage, one volt per distribution from 0V for Discr to 4V for Exp, and moves the selector while it is patched
Sets the seed by voltage in place of the Seed knob, 0-10V mapped onto 0 to 1, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets the density by voltage in place of the Dens knob, 0-10V mapped onto 0 to 1, and moves the knob while it is patched

outputs.text: The first sixteen of the 32 values at the reading point, one per channel
The last sixteen of the 32 values at the reading point, one per channel, numbered 16 to 31 despite the panel printing Out15-31

notes: the cube holds 32 values on each node of a 7 by 7 by 7 lattice, and a reading between nodes is interpolated from the eight around it, so the outputs change smoothly as X, Y and Z move
turning the Dens or Seed knob changes nothing until the knob is let go; the cube is then refilled in a background thread, which the patch carries on playing through
